title: CafeKit runtime configuration
description: Project-scoped CafeKit settings, installed as .claude/runtime.json and .codex/runtime.json. Every key is optional; an absent key keeps the built-in default. Editors that honour $schema use this file for completion and inline documentation. Secrets do not belong here: this file is meant to be committed.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema. Present so editors can validate the file; CafeKit itself ignores it.

privacyBlock.description: Block reads of files that usually hold secrets (.env, credentials, keys). Set false to disable the privacy hook for this project.

inspect.description: The guard that steers broad codebase searches toward the discovery workflow.

enabled.description: Set false to stop the inspect guard from blocking broad search commands.

docs.description: Documentation conventions surfaced to the agent.

maxLoc.description: Lines allowed in one documentation file before the agent is reminded to split it.

paths.description: Where this project keeps its documentation, specifications, and plans, relative to the repository root.

docs.description: Documentation root the docs workflow reads and writes.

specs.description: Specification packet root: one direct child per feature.

plans.description: Directory holding plan files, one directory per plan.

spec.description: Specification workflow guards. These are convenience switches for local work, not authorizations.

scaffold_guard.description: Not honoured. The task-scaffold guard that read this key was removed; the key is kept so existing runtime.json files stay valid.

tollgate.description: Report specification state on each prompt. Set false to silence it.

completion_gate.description: Not a switch. The completion gate treats this flag as a bypass attempt and blocks while it is present, whatever its value, because a worker-writable file cannot authorize completion. Remove the key and satisfy the gate instead.

usage.description: Not honoured. The usage hook that read this key was removed; the statusline takes quota from the rate_limits Claude Code sends. Kept so existing runtime.json files stay valid.

enabled.description: Not honoured. Nothing fetches quota data any more.

locale.description: Languages the agent should use. null means English, or match the user.

codingLevel.description: Codex only. How much explanation answers carry: 0 ELI5, 1 junior, 2 mid-level, 3 senior, 4 lead, 5 expert. Codex CLI has no output-style feature, so the rules hook injects the matching file from .codex/output-styles/ once per session. Claude Code loads the same styles natively and reads outputStyle from settings.json instead, so this key is ignored there. null or an out-of-range value injects nothing.

statusline.description: How much the statusline renders. 'none' prints an empty line.

statuslineColors.description: Set false for a statusline without ANSI colour.

statuslineLayout.description: Explicit statusline composition. A valid layout replaces the default renderers; an invalid or empty one falls back to them. The 'statusline' mode still limits how many lines are drawn.

lines.description: One entry per rendered line, each listing section ids in display order.

assertions.description: Rules injected for files matching a glob.

pattern.description: Glob the rule applies to, for example "**/*.go".

rule.description: The rule text shown to the agent.

trust.description: Local trust prompt. Keep the passphrase in your own user configuration, never in this committed file.

enabled.description: Whether a trust passphrase is required.

passphrase.description: Do not set this here. This file is committed.

project.description: Detection overrides for a repository the defaults read wrong.

dateFormat.description: Date portion of the plan name.

issuePrefix.description: Prefix for the issue portion, for example "GH-".

resolution.description: How the active plan is chosen. Only explicit session state makes a plan active; a branch match is a suggestion.

order.description: Order the sources are consulted in when resolving the active plan.

branchPattern.description: Regular expression extracting a plan slug from the branch name.

hooks.description: Not honoured. No hook consults this map, so an entry here disables nothing. Disable a hook by removing its entry from the host's hook configuration instead.

develop.description: Not honoured. Parallel execution is chosen per invocation with the --parallel flag, not from this file.
